hero.subtitle: Complete metadata, copy, and checklist for submitting Spellful to the App Store and Google Play.

descriptions.promotional: Your complete witchcraft companion. Personalized horoscopes, 78-card tarot, moon rituals, and a private grimoire — all in one sacred space.
descriptions.short: Personalized horoscopes, 78-card tarot, moon rituals & grimoire journaling. Your witchcraft companion.
descriptions.full:
Spellful is your complete witchcraft companion — built for practitioners of every level, from curious beginners to seasoned witches.

PERSONALIZED DAILY HOROSCOPE
Enter your birth date and receive a horoscope tailored to your sun sign every morning. Spellful uses astronomically accurate calculations to track the moon, planets, and transits that matter to your practice.

78-CARD TAROT DECK
Explore all 78 tarot cards with original hand-crafted artwork. Choose from five spreads — one-card daily draw, three-card past/present/future, Celtic Cross, new moon, and shadow work. Each card includes upright and reversed meanings, symbolism, and journaling prompts.

MOON RITUAL PLANNER
Follow the lunar cycle with 48 rituals aligned to every moon phase. From new moon intentions to full moon releases, Spellful guides your practice through the complete lunar calendar.

BIRTH CHART & SYNASTRY
Generate your full natal chart with VSOP87 astronomical accuracy — 10 planets, Ascendant, and Midheaven. Explore synastry with a partner to understand your astrological compatibility.

PERSONAL GRIMOIRE
Keep a private digital grimoire with your spells, rituals, herbs, and intentions. Add dream journal entries, shadow work reflections, and track your practice over time.

SPELLFUL ACADEMY
Learn witchcraft through 22 structured lessons across 9 topics — from tarot basics to advanced lunar magic. Complete quizzes, earn progress, and bookmark lessons for later.

COMMUNITY
Connect with a private community of practitioners. Share insights, ask questions, and grow your practice alongside others.

FEATURES:
• Astronomically accurate moon phase engine (±2 min accuracy)
• 78-card tarot deck with original artwork and 5 spreads
• Daily horoscope personalized to your birth chart
• Full natal chart and synastry wheel
• 48 moon rituals across all lunar phases
• Personal grimoire, dream journal & shadow work
• Herb library with 49 botanicals
• Spellful Academy with 22 lessons
• Private community with polls and Q&A
• Push notifications for moon phases and practice reminders
• No ads. Free to download.

CHECKLIST.item: Google Play Developer account active ($25 one-time)
App binary (IPA / AAB) built and signed
App icon 1024×1024 px (no alpha, no rounded corners)
Screenshots captured for all required sizes
All metadata fields filled in App Store Connect
All metadata fields filled in Google Play Console
Age rating questionnaire completed on both stores
Data safety / privacy nutrition label completed
Test flight / internal testing build approved
